Summary:
  > - Cell = text-only task, main score of the first declared standard split, one revision per model dir (most task files), modal dataset_revision and modal subset set (languages averaged), config variants dropped, org = group. Coverage filter tasks>=50 models, models>=30 tasks (iterated). **Realised shape 238 models x 328 tasks, 45,775 cells (density 0.586), 83 org groups**, largest group 12. G1 met. N is large because MTEB tasks are fine-grained, so k <= floor(N/3)=109; the grid is {1,2,3,5,8,12,20,32,50,80,109}.
  > - Disclosed: the coverage thresholds were picked after viewing a table of counts (no scores).
  > - delta = mean over target cells of min(0.5 x median adjacent gap, 0.25 x all-others floor RMSE), per fold from training models; numbers will be committed in `prereg/delta_by_fold.csv` before the contrast is run.
  > - **One decision to flag:** since delta <= 0.25 floor, "error <= epsilon" with epsilon = delta can never be reached on raw error. I define k*(epsilon) on the excess over the model's own all-others floor (same targets), epsilon in {delta, 2 delta}. Tell me if you want it otherwise.
  > - Verdict rule, bootstrap (83 groups, 5000 reps), k exclusion counts, fixed subsets A/B: as in the file.
  > - **Baselines not runnable as published (your decision whether they stay):** P6 (Ruan/Sloth) needs a complete row of base-benchmark scores and compute/family covariates, so it will be run as PC-regression on the factor-model latent scores with a sigmoid link (an adaptation); S4 (pivoted QR) needs a complete matrix -> applied to the EM-completed matrix; S7 (Golbandi tree) is defined for discrete ratings -> continuous-score kNN/tree interview; S3 wrapper restricted to k<=32 for cost; S8 exhaustive oracle only possible on N<=10 matrices (Open LLM LB, HELM Lite), on MTEB replaced by exhaustive/swap checks on small random task subsets. S0, S1, S2, S5, P0, P1, P3, P4 run as published.
